traced.thresholds: Each hybrid group: lower warm median/p95; keyword unchanged or lower. All groups: no new first or warm-max tail, zero failures. No outlier replacement or retry.

untraced.thresholds: Each hybrid group: lower warm median/p95; keyword unchanged or lower. All groups: no new first or warm-max tail, zero failures. No outlier replacement or retry.

method_limitations: Four sequential roles: baseline traced, candidate traced, candidate ordinary, baseline ordinary.
Each group retains1 first-observed and20 warmed attempts; first-observed is not a cold-start claim.
Traced performance follows the paired quality evaluation; instrumentation changes the timing boundary/cost, so ordinary and traced results are kept separate.
Conventional warm median and nearest-rank p95; all first/max tails and failures retained without retries or exclusions.
Mac ARM results do not qualify Intel macOS or Linux allocator changes.
Nested phase elapsed time is not exclusive CPU or proof of an allocator/SDK/HTTP scheduling cause.
The shared serialization precision fix is an explicit matched prerequisite; historical rejected seals/failed restore evidence remain immutable.
